agents.notes: Two traps in one row. Resume is a SUBCOMMAND, so `cinder --resume <id>` exits 2 with "unexpected argument" and leaves a dead pane. And the usage is `cinder [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`, so the launch flags have to lead. `cinder resume <id> --skip-onboarding` dies the same way. Keeping the flag matters, because it is what stops a restored pane opening the first run dialog.
